scene_prompt: Modern school team strategy game outdoors, no military weapons. Three children in matching plain green sports bibs crouch calmly together behind a low hedge at the edge of a large capture-the-flag field. Their captain gently holds up an open palm to signal WAIT, teammates stay still and watch. In the distance two other teams wearing blue and orange bibs run toward a plain colored cloth flag. The green team deliberately chooses to observe the unfolding situation before moving, all alert and ready rather than asleep or afraid. Foreground green children clear and prominent, background small and simple. Natural hands and joints, feet grounded, sensible hedge perspective, no readable text letters numbers logos or watermarks. Landscape 3:2, original characters, graphite pencil outlines, soft watercolor, colored pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper.
